source_title: Trump calls Brazil’s election ‘rigged’ as allies stoke fraud fears ahead of midterms
source_excerpt:
A week before the U.S. midterm election, President Donald Trump and prominent right-wing figures revived a familiar playbook, casting doubt on the results of Brazil’s presidential election and promoting unfounded claims of fraud after a right-wing candidate with MAGA ties lost in Sunday’s vote.
